content: Kweiboug, tut babaw, ked kweitan kweitan waseg, Yowbad anilivan isekes tammwayas. Anilivan bo isekes tasiyas palopits mo ikatpeles, isekes tammwayas.
Tage nakabiyokous tut, nagein waseg, anilivan bo isekeids Natun waseg. Bo isek Natun youd babaw nisesus, mamagina nakiyay tatonen. O tut kweiboug, Natun ileb Taman, mo ibun ven watinow.

Natun mititeilin ivag mamagina Yowbad yakawanan, peinan askakin katanok-wan. Anilivan tawtoun waseg bo ikimtuwes youd babaw ven watinow o walba̱lab, va̱gan biwotets bwein. Bo iwid adsinaps kalbaleb ikous, mo isin Yowbad wanaka̱tay walba̱lab.
E, Natun yagan imug; min-liba̱lab asibabaw yiges ikuyeim. Natawtoun-vak bo imug wasigeis tasiyas min-liba̱lab.
Yowbad nag teitan gum-liba̱lab bidibek mamagina:

content.text: “Yak Natug, nagein bo kumlavag Natug”; nag.

content: Misinaka Natun tatonen idibek ma̱wan. Kweitan-vak Yowbad anilivan, idibek Deibid mamagina:
Kwatounun livan, misiya̱mun nisen Natun kunutaw ven watinow waseg, ilivan mamagina:
Liva̱nen tasiyas Yowbad nataka̱yobs ilivan mamagina:

content.text: o natouwat tasiyas iva̱ges mamagina mayen kov.”

content: Tage liva̱nen Natun nises Bukitab waseg mamagina:

content.text: Ivag sivinam sinap didumwal; sinap kaydodog kupiyev.
Mapuna Yowbad bo nisekeim mumwa̱saw singay.
mo bukwatpum bukwatlow ma̱wana kweim tonen;
“Kusin wagunka̱tay mo bavag mukwaleiwag wasigeis tasiyas nikamliweims ya̱koum.
E, mo bimlavags mamagina mukwabtatet tasiyas.”

content: Nag. Misinaka Natun tatonen idibek ma̱wan.
Peinan min-liba̱lab mamagina kalisiy kululuwes tasiyas. Yowbad ikayyabes kid bimtakavateids gamag mwasanin ya̱kids, kalisiy wasigeis ya̱kids Yowbad mo bikatinabwes.
